name: thread-marketplace
description: The thread plugin for Claude Code: a local board where Claude's tasks, questions and reviews land on cards, you answer them together, and work with acceptance criteria waits for your approval.

plugins.name: thread
plugins.description: A local board for Claude Code: Claude records tasks and asks its questions and reviews as waiting items on cards, you answer them together, and a task with acceptance criteria is not marked done until you approve. Sub-agent runs, side threads and Codex, OpenCode or Claude lane work show live on the cards they belong to.
